# PopupTrigger — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A wrapper component that attaches a floating popup panel to any element — wrap a button, icon, link, or any React node as `children` to make it open the popup on click.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below.
